article.story: LEWISTON, N.Y. -- — Brandon Benjamin had 23 points to lead Fairfield to an 83-75 victory over Niagara on Sunday. Benjamin added nine rebounds and three blocks for the Stags (9-7, 1-4 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Deuce Turner shot 5 for 9 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line to add 17 points. Braden Sparks had 15 points. Justin Page finished with 21 points and two blocks for the Purple Eagles (4-10, 1-3). Niagara also got 12 points, seven rebounds and four blocks from Will Shortt. Landon Williams added 11 points and four assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
